requirements.quote: create the directory `/home/user/report` if it does not yet exist and write a new file called `/home/user/report/low_stock_report.json`.
The file content must be a compact (minified) JSON array that lists, in the order they appear in `inventory.json`, the `id` numbers of every product whose quantity is strictly less than 10.
The file must contain exactly one trailing newline character and nothing else (no spaces, no pretty printing).
Clean up after yourself and delete `/opt/store/clover` entirely.
